title: polygonum persicaria var. ruderale
intro: Polygonum persicaria var. ruderale, commonly known as Red Shiso, is a variety of the Polygonum persicaria plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the buckwheat family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Red Shiso include anti-edematous, anti-allergic, and wound-healing properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Red Shiso include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
